segmentation.text: or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency,
making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of
the driver of every other vehicle shall,
except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer:
Except as otherwise provided in this paragraph,
drive to a position parallel to, and
as close as possible to, the right-hand edge or, if applicable, curb of a highway
The driver shall not drive to and stop in a position on a paved shoulder of a highway
where lawfully placed signage allows a vehicle described in paragraphs (a) to (f), inclusive, of subsection 4 of NRS 484B.210 [list appended below] to drive on the shoulder.

The provisions of subparagraph (1) of paragraph (c) of subsection 1 do not apply to: (a) An authorized emergency vehicle described in NRS 484A.480; (b) A vehicle which has been issued a permit to operate as an authorized emergency vehicle pursuant to NRS 484A.490; (c) A traffic incident management vehicle; (d) A tow car; (e) A coroner vehicle; or (f) A public transit motor bus, that is being driven on the paved shoulder of a highway where lawfully placed signage allows that vehicle to use the shoulder in that manner.

elements.justification: Admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle ('a vehicle permitted to depart from certain traffic laws when equipped and operated in the manner provided by law'); ru.aggregate 'membership of a legal aggregate'; conduct carried by u4 and u1.

ru.official_vehicle 'a vehicle in official or contracted road service ...; kind in {... regulatory_agency ...}', read with kind regulatory_agency; 'Not a stand-in for: an emergency vehicle' respected.

sig.warning_lamp 'a warning lamp lit; colour ..., mode ..., facing ...', read as colour red, mode flashing, facing front from the quoted requirement 'at least one flashing red warning lamp visible from the front'; not a stand-in for an audible warning.
Admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'every other' excludes the approaching vehicle; 'driver' read through the vehicle's controlled motion.

Mapping index: 'unless otherwise directed by a Police Officer' maps to dev.governs, dev.human_direction, rel.occupies, st.travel_region; read with role police_officer governing a travel region the subject occupies.

'drive to and stop': the subject comes to rest, drv.motion.complete_halt ('at rest at the observation — complete cessation from movement', DEF-NRS-484A-255, the definition of 'stop' when required, here the stop the words forbid in a place) holding at this observation and not at the previous one; 'in a position on a paved shoulder of a highway': its footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) a st.shoulder region ('the part of the highway beside the roadway not intended for vehicular traffic; paved attribute') with paved attribute, lying (st.on_way) on a highway region (st.highway 'the entire public way ... including sidewalks and shoulders').

'lawfully placed signage allows ... to drive on the shoulder': dev.regulatory_sign 'a point regulation by catalogue code ... shoulder_use_permitted', governing (dev.governs 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls — ... or shoulder') the shoulder of b6. Its exclusion 'Not a stand-in for: a manoeuvre or a road feature' is respected: the sign is read as the condition, the shoulder is its own atom. 'lawfully placed' is the sign's status, read by its presence.

The appended list (NRS 484B.210(4)) describes the vehicles ('(a) An authorized emergency vehicle ... (f) A public transit motor bus') that 'lawfully placed signage allows ... to use the shoulder': it is the legend of the shoulder_use_permitted regulatory sign b7 reads (dev.regulatory_sign, 'with the same structured conditions attribute ... a class'). The subject's duty does not depend on its own class, so the listed classes are read only as what the sign allows.

operationalizations.standard: the immediate approach of the emergency or regulatory vehicle
operationalizations.convention: the vehicle moves with the subject ahead of it in its own frame, within the centre distance a vehicle at an urban response speed covers in the time a driver needs to perceive its lamps and begin clearing the way

compositions.quote: at least one flashing red warning lamp visible from the front

applicability: There is a road user e, not the subject, of the authorized-emergency-vehicle aggregate or an official vehicle of kind regulatory_agency, showing a lit warning lamp of colour red, mode flashing, facing front, moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) with the subject ahead of it in its frame (rel.bearing longitudinal positive), within centre distance p.emergency_immediate_approach_reach; and no human_direction device of role police_officer governs a travel region the subject occupies.
obligation: It is not the case that the subject comes to rest at this observation (drv.motion.complete_halt with speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance holds here and did not at the previous observation) while its footprint overlaps a shoulder region with paved attribute, lying on a highway region, that a regulatory sign of code shoulder_use_permitted governs.

narrowings.why: 'driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion
'lawfully placed signage' is read by the sign's presence governing the shoulder

'drive to and stop' is read as the subject coming to rest on such a shoulder while the emergency vehicle's immediate approach lasts; a vehicle already at rest there before the approach began is not judged

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: Ambulance e with a lit red flashing front lamp approaches the moving subject within p.emergency_immediate_approach_reach; the subject pulls onto a paved shoulder governed by a shoulder_use_permitted regulatory sign and comes to rest there (complete_halt rises).

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but the subject comes to rest at the roadway edge with its footprint off that shoulder.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: No vehicle with lit warning lamps approaches; the subject stops on the signed shoulder.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but sig.warning_lamp is not observed, so whether the duty is engaged is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but the paved shoulder carries no shoulder_use_permitted sign: stopping there is allowed.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition standard's vehicle-state estimates

param_proposals.name: p.emergency_immediate_approach_reach
param_proposals.convention: centre distance within which an emergency or enforcement vehicle closing on a road user with its warning lamps flashing is in immediate approach: about five seconds of travel at an urban response speed of 20 m/s, the time a driver needs to perceive the lamps and begin to clear the way
param_proposals.source: driver-response studies of emergency-vehicle encounters (perception-reaction time plus lane-change time)
